title: Automated stability & regression checker for quantized model rollouts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an automated harness that verifies behavioral stability and accuracy regressions for FP8/INT8 quantized model variants prior to and during rollouts. The harness will run curated "golden" prompt families plus adversarial perturbations, produce a battery of deterministic and stochastic metrics (token-KL, top-k overlap, embedding cosine drift, semantic pass/fail), and emit a pass/fail gate used by the rollout service to block or allow canary and full deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Harness runs end-to-end on dedicated CI with reproducible outputs when seed is fixed
Defines >=3 metric families (syntactic: top-k overlap, token-KL; semantic: embedding-cosine; stability: generation variance) with clear thresholds and per-corpus baselines
Implements multi-run ensemble mode (N>=5) to quantify nondeterminism introduced by quantization
Outputs a machine-readable gate result (PASS / WARN / FAIL) consumed by rollout API: /rollout/v1/gate-check
Includes dashboards: per-prompt deltas, per-layer sensitivity heatmap, and trendline across commits
CI job fails only on FAIL; WARN surfaces but does not block canary if policy allows (configurable)
Documentation: runbook + golden prompt curation guide + instructions for adding new profiles
implementation_notes: Architecture: runner service that replays prompts to a control (fp16) and candidate (fp8/int8) replica; collector aggregates token streams, logits, and embeddings
Determinism: use fixed RNG seeds, disable sampling (temperature=0) for deterministic checks; separate stochastic mode enables multiple draws and stats
Metric computation: token-KL computed over softmax logits after aligning vocabulary and subtokenization; embedding drift via L2-normalized cosine on mean-pooled last-layer tokens
Goldens: group prompts into families (instructional, long-context, dialogue multi-turn, code, math), include edge cases and rate-limited prefixes
Calibration workflow: automated calibration step for INT8 per-profile with stored calibration artifacts (per-channel scale tables); harness can accept calibration snapshot as input
Per-layer sensitivity: integrate with quant profiler outputs to weight metrics (e.g., errors in high-sensitivity layers flagged higher)
Performance: run batch-parallel replay on 4x A100-dedicated canary nodes; estimate runtime ~45m per full-run for 10k prompt family when multi-run ensemble N=5
Fail gating: tiered gates (critical, high, low) mapped to thresholds and action (block, warn, manual-review)
Integration: gate result posted to rollout service and recorded in console under model-version and rollout-id for observability
risk: CPU/GPU cost: full-suite runs are expensive; need dedicated canary capacity or nightly window
False positives from brittle thresholds on rare tokenization edge-cases
Stochastic drift: some model families exhibit higher variance post-quant that requires more ensemble runs to stabilize
Calibration mismatch: ingesting incorrect calibration snapshot can produce misleading pass results
